templates.pattern: What is the smallest number to subtract from [N] to make it exactly divisible by [D]?
templates.explanation:
To make [N] divisible by [D], find the remainder.
[N] ÷ [D] = [floor(N/D)] remainder [N % D].
Subtract the remainder: [N] - [N % D] = [N - N % D].
So the smallest number to subtract = [RESULT].

Verify: [N - N % D] ÷ [D] = [floor(N/D)] exactly.

templates.pattern: How many numbers between [A] and [B] (inclusive) are divisible by [D]?
templates.explanation:
Count of numbers from [A] to [B] divisible by [D]:
= floor([B] ÷ [D]) - floor(([A]-1) ÷ [D])
= [floor(B/D)] - [floor((A-1)/D)]
= [RESULT]

Rule: floor(B/D) - floor((A-1)/D)

templates.pattern: A number when divided by [D] leaves remainder [R]. What is the remainder when twice that number is divided by [D]?
templates.explanation:
Let the number be N where N mod [D] = [R].
Twice the number = 2N.
2N mod [D] = (2 × [R]) mod [D]
= [2*R] mod [D]
= [RESULT]

Rule: (2 × remainder) mod divisor

templates.pattern: Find the remainder when [A] × [B] + [C] is divided by [D].
templates.explanation:
Find remainder of ([A] × [B] + [C]) ÷ [D].
[A] × [B] = [A*B].
[A*B] + [C] = [A*B+C].
[A*B+C] ÷ [D] gives remainder [RESULT].

Shortcut: (([A] mod [D]) × ([B] mod [D]) + [C] mod [D]) mod [D] = [RESULT]

templates.pattern: What least value must be added to [N] so that the sum is divisible by [D]?
templates.explanation:
Find remainder when [N] ÷ [D].
Remainder = [N % D].
To make it divisible, add [D] - [N % D] = [RESULT].
[N] + [RESULT] = [N + D - N % D].

Answer: [RESULT]

templates.pattern: Two numbers leave remainders [R1] and [R2] respectively when divided by [D]. What is the remainder when their product is divided by [D]?
templates.explanation:
Let the two numbers be N1 and N2.
N1 mod [D] = [R1], N2 mod [D] = [R2].
(N1 × N2) mod [D] = (N1 mod [D]) × (N2 mod [D]) mod [D]
= [R1] × [R2] mod [D]
= [R1*R2] mod [D]
= [RESULT]

Rule: (A × B) mod D = ((A mod D) × (B mod D)) mod D

templates.pattern: How many numbers from 1 to [N] are divisible by [D1] or [D2]?
templates.calculation: floor(N / D1) + floor(N / D2) - floor(N / (D1 * D2))
templates.explanation:
Using inclusion-exclusion principle:
Divisible by [D1]: floor([N]/[D1]) = [floor(N/D1)]
Divisible by [D2]: floor([N]/[D2]) = [floor(N/D2)]
Divisible by both: floor([N]/[D1*D2]) = [floor(N/(D1*D2))]

Total = [floor(N/D1)] + [floor(N/D2)] - [floor(N/(D1*D2))] = [RESULT]

Rule: |A∪B| = |A| + |B| - |A∩B|

templates.pattern: If N = [Q] × [D] + [R], what is the remainder when N + [D] is divided by [D]?
templates.explanation:
N = [Q] × [D] + [R], so N mod [D] = [R].
N + [D] = [Q] × [D] + [R] + [D] = ([Q]+1) × [D] + [R].
Remainder when (N + [D]) ÷ [D] = [R].

Rule: Adding the divisor does not change the remainder.
Answer: [RESULT]

templates.pattern: What is the remainder when [A]² + [B]² is divided by [D]?
templates.explanation:
Find remainder of ([A]² + [B]²) ÷ [D].
[A]² = [A*A], [B]² = [B*B].
[A*A] + [B*B] = [A*A+B*B].
[A*A+B*B] ÷ [D] gives remainder [RESULT].

Shortcut: (([A] mod [D])² + ([B] mod [D])²) mod [D] = [RESULT]

templates.pattern: A number N gives remainder [R] when divided by [D]. What is the remainder when N² is divided by [D]?
templates.explanation:
N mod [D] = [R].
N² mod [D] = (N mod [D])² mod [D]
= [R]² mod [D]
= [R*R] mod [D]
= [RESULT]

Rule: (N²) mod D = (N mod D)² mod D
